technical.summary: Bullish technical setup with strong moving average alignment and reversal patterns, but weak trend strength (ADX 12.98) and overbought oscillators limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: TSCO shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 30 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure with small amounts from non-senior members; broad market fear (36/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (229.4) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 30 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for discretionary consumer stock.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three-white-soldiers reversal pattern with EMA 9/21 golden cross provides technical setup for mean reversion entry in fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis, broad market capitulation).
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch RSI, Williams %R), weak ADX trend strength (12.98), absent volume confirmation (OBV), zero fundamental conviction, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 229.4, earnings risk in 30 days) create asymmetric risk-reward against entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical reversal setup (three white soldiers, EMA golden cross) offers mean reversion opportunity in fear-zone market; however, conviction is insufficient given macro severity and fundamental vacuum.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 30 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (229.4) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding TSCO with 56 existing Consumer Discretionary positions (13.7% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and warrant position skip.
